name: embabel-worlds
description: Your own Embabel appliance in Claude Code: a connection to it over MCP, and the skills that survey a business for realms and agents, author views, handlers and apps, verify them against the source system, and diagnose a realm or an install that is not working.

appliance_url.title: Appliance URL
appliance_url.description: Where your appliance's server answers, without a trailing slash. Embabel Worlds installs on http://localhost:11043 and Embabel Me on http://localhost:11042; a remote install is its https:// address.

api_key.title: API key
api_key.description: A key from the console, under Keys to this world, or the token first-run setup minted. Sent only to the appliance URL above, as a Bearer token.
